parameter_semantics: target_object selects red_pose relational features and the red phase object; successor_object selects blue_pose overlap features and phase object; buffer_pose_world is [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] in world metres/wxyz and supplies the intended center relation and phase reference. Training binds [-0.181,0,0.02,1,0,0,0].
output_semantics: Each slot is [delta_x,delta_y,delta_z,rotvec_x,rotvec_y,rotvec_z,gripper]. Translation is a world-axis metre displacement from chunk-start TCP. rotvec is radians for R_target*R_anchor^T and left-multiplies the chunk-start TCP rotation. Anchor is fixed for a sampled chunk. The reconstructed world pose is sent only through panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured qpos; gripper sign is native. Slots are t-1..t+14 and slots 1..8 execute.

conversion_check.description: Command FK targets are encoded as chunk-start TCP world translation and SO(3) log residuals, then reconstructed by the inverse exponential-map operation before shared IK. The check compares world TCP position, rotation and gripper.

cut_relation: Every assigned action in all 12 [0,stop) segments supervises diffusion and receives a causal current-phase target. The 210-230 action overlap with place_blue remains action-supervised from red lowering/release through blue initial lift.
